sourceText.he: רַבִּי דּוֹסָא בֶּן הַרְכִּינָס אוֹמֵר וְכוּ׳. וְכַמָּה ״כׇּל שֶׁהֵן״? אָמַר רַב: מָנֶה וּפְרָס, וּבִלְבַד שֶׁיְּהוּ מְחוּמָּשׁוֹת, וּשְׁמוּאֵל אָמַר: שִׁשִּׁים, וְנוֹתֵן סֶלַע אַחַת לְכֹהֵן.

positions.claim: each of the five sheep must yield a maneh and a peras
five sheep of any amount of shearing suffice
‘any amount’ is a maneh and a peras in all, provided it is divided equally among the five
‘any amount’ is sixty sela, of which one sela is given to the priest
